Your agent passed your test… and failed a hundred users.
Welcome to Agent School — lesson twenty-five.
Real users ask in ways you never imagined.
And AI is random — it can pass once and fail the next time.
That's why builders use evals: a test set of real examples, each with what a good answer looks like.
Every time you change the prompt or the model, run all of them — and get a score.
Did it get better… or worse?
And every failure a user reports becomes a new test.
Your eval set grows smarter every week.
Remember: one good demo proves nothing.
A test set with a score proves progress.
